text: Qatar Holding LLC holds 10.4% of Volkswagen AG's subscribed capital and, with 17.0% of the voting rights, was the third-largest shareholder in Volkswagen AG (Volkswagen Group Annual Report 2025, shareholder structure).

source.name: Volkswagen Group, Annual Report 2025 (PDF), p. 108
source.quote: Qatar Holding LLC was the third-largest shareholder with 17.0%.
